newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end up but pare gains towards close.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end up but pare gains towards close.

text.p: *Key June JGB futures ended a bit higher after paring some gains towards close due to Jiji news agency report quoting key business leader as saying review of Japan's monetary policy may get under way from summer, traders said.
*Traders said downside limited by demand for JGBs on dips.
